name: gayatama
description: Data-driven micro-business location scoring for Indonesia, built on open data.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gayatama/scoring && concurrently --names scoring,api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @gayatama/scoring" "npm run dev -w @gayatama/api" "npm run dev -w @gayatama/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @gayatama/scoring && npm run dev -w @gayatama/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @gayatama/scoring && npm run dev -w @gayatama/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @gayatama/scoring && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gayatama/scoring && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
